_comment: pps-specific acceptance fixture (task 011). NOT read by scripts/acceptance-diff.sh by default — pass its path via --symbols so the harness script itself stays project-agnostic (code-standards.md: 'nothing pps-specific' in shipped script logic). Each entry names ONE real Uptactics symbol (read from app/code/Uptactics/*/etc/{di,events}.xml on 2026-07-31, read-only). new_stack_symbol uses the exact codegraph qualified_name form (Ns\Sub::ClassName) to avoid ambiguous bare-name collisions (see docs/acceptance-report-pps-2026-07-31.md 'Symbol selection' section for the collision counts that made this necessary). legacy_target/legacy_file_path mirror the same disambiguation for the legacy impact tool's target/file_path params.

symbols.label: plugin-wrapped-method
symbols.description: Uptactics_PpsTheme plugin (aroundGetBreadcrumbPath) wrapping Magento\Catalog\Helper\Data — app/code/Uptactics/PpsTheme/etc/di.xml sortOrder=1.

symbols.label: event-observer
symbols.description: Uptactics_ShipperHqCarrier observer on checkout_onepage_controller_success_action (app/code/Uptactics/ShipperHqCarrier/etc/frontend/events.xml). Same event also carries a second, unrelated observer (Uptactics_TaxCompanyValue's SetCompanyName) — a real multi-observer event.

symbols.label: preference-redirect
symbols.description: Uptactics_JournalReport di.xml preference redirecting Magento\Reports\Model\ResourceModel\Product\Sold\Collection to the project's own Collection (app/code/Uptactics/JournalReport/etc/di.xml).

symbols.label: cross-db-mage-os-extends
symbols.description: Uptactics_JournalReport grid renderer extending mage-os core Magento\Backend\Block\Widget\Grid\Column\Renderer\AbstractRenderer directly in PHP (no XML wiring involved) — exercises the native (non-augmenter) cross-DB boundary: core is not indexed in the scratch project DB.

symbols.label: negative-control-no-wiring
symbols.description: Uptactics_CustomOptionQtyLimit config helper — never named as a di.xml preference/plugin target, an events.xml observer, a layout block/template, or a webapi/routes target anywhere under app/code/Uptactics. Expect zero magento-kind (wraps/preference_for/observes/renders) edges on both backends.
